component.name: Screen Sharing
Skärmdelning
component.summary: See and control the screens of other computers
Se och styr skärmen på andra datorer

description.p: Connects to computers that share their screen over VNC (RFB), found nearby or typed as a vnc:// address. Connections are encrypted with TLS when the other computer offers it; its certificate is remembered the first time and a change is pointed out. Keys and the pointer go to the other computer after a click, Ctrl+Alt gives them back, and copied text crosses in both directions.
